# Machine settings

Precedence: flag > KITBAG_* environment > config.toml > default. Empty flag/environment strings are unset. Only the winning override is validated; the stored file must always be valid.

Use `kitbag config get <key>`, `set <key> <value>`, `unset <key>`, `list`, `explain <key>` or `edit`. Values for strings are raw text; booleans, integers and arrays use TOML literals. `get` prints the value, while `list` and `explain` include its source and redact sensitive values.

`set` and `unset` validate the complete resulting file and write atomically with mode 0600. Required keys cannot be removed. Identity name/email must be changed together with `edit`. TOML encoding normalizes formatting; files containing any `#` are conservatively refused, including hashes inside strings. Use `edit` to preserve comments. Unknown keys are rejected. To create a file, first set `repo.url`, or use `init`/`edit`.

`edit` runs `$EDITOR` as a shell command with a separate quoted draft filename argument. Editor arguments are supported. It validates on exit and offers re-edit or abort (the default, including EOF). The original stays intact on invalid input, editor failure or abort. A private adjacent draft is removed on exit; after a crash, inspect and remove the leftover draft before retrying. Configuration mutations share a nonblocking lock; external edits detected before saving are refused.

`--config` > `KITBAG_CONFIG` > the platform config directory selects the file; these selectors are not config.toml keys. The repo, branch and identity flags apply to init only. Paths explicitly selected by config commands may be absent to allow first-run setup. Dynamic defaults: `host` uses the short hostname, `repo.branch` follows the remote default and `repo.path` uses the platform data directory. `sync.mode` defaults to link on Unix and copy on future Windows (Windows runtime is deferred).

| Key | Type | Default | Environment | Flag | Allowed | Sensitive | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schema` | integer | `1` | `` | `` | 1 | false | Configuration schema version. |
| `host` | string | `machine short hostname` | `KITBAG_HOST` | `host` | ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$ | false | Manifest host selector; default is the machine's short hostname. |
| `repo.url` | string | `unset` | `KITBAG_REPO_URL` | `repo` | ^[^\s]+$ | true | Configuration repository URL; required in a saved file. Never include credentials. |
| `repo.branch` | string | `remote default branch` | `KITBAG_REPO_BRANCH` | `branch` | ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9/_.-]{0,254}$ | false | Branch to follow; unset follows the remote default. |
| `repo.path` | string | `platform data directory / repos / repository name` | `KITBAG_REPO_PATH` | `` | home path, at most 4096 bytes | false | Working copy below HOME; unset uses the platform data directory. |
| `git.backend` | string | `auto` | `KITBAG_GIT_BACKEND` | `git-backend` | auto, system, embedded | false | Prefer system Git automatically, or force one backend. |
| `git.identity.name` | string | `unset` | `KITBAG_GIT_IDENTITY_NAME` | `identity-name` | ^[^<>\r\n\x00]+$ | true | Fallback embedded commit author; name and email must be configured together. |
| `git.identity.email` | string | `unset` | `KITBAG_GIT_IDENTITY_EMAIL` | `identity-email` | ^[^<>\s\x00]+@[^<>\s\x00]+$ | true | Fallback embedded commit email; name and email must be configured together. |
| `sync.poll_interval` | string | `60s` | `KITBAG_SYNC_POLL_INTERVAL` | `` | duration from 1s to 24h (ms, s, m, h) | false | Remote head polling interval; 1s minimum, 24h maximum. |
| `daemon.debounce` | string | `500ms` | `KITBAG_DAEMON_DEBOUNCE` | `` | duration from 100ms to 1m (ms, s, m, h) | false | Watcher coalescing window; 100ms minimum, 1m maximum. |
| `daemon.update_check` | boolean | `true` | `KITBAG_DAEMON_UPDATE_CHECK` | `` | true, false | false | Check release metadata daily; never download or install. |
| `daemon.release_url` | string | `https://api.github.com/repos/TomaszJanusz/kitbag/releases/latest` | `KITBAG_DAEMON_RELEASE_URL` | `` | ^https?://[^\s]+$ | false | Latest release JSON endpoint; restart daemon after changing daemon settings. |
| `sync.mode` | string | `link (Unix), copy (Windows)` | `KITBAG_MODE` | `mode` | link, copy | false | Machine materialization default; manifest copy still wins. |
| `ui.notifications` | boolean | `true` | `KITBAG_UI_NOTIFICATIONS` | `` | true, false | false | Show notifications after changes (desktop UI is planned). |
| `ui.theme` | string | `auto` | `KITBAG_UI_THEME` | `` | auto, dark, light | false | UI theme (desktop UI is planned). |
| `ui.color` | string | `auto` | `KITBAG_UI_COLOR` | `` | auto, always, never | false | Terminal color preference; NO_COLOR disables color. |
| `migration.legacy_roots` | array | `[]` | `KITBAG_MIGRATION_LEGACY_ROOTS` | `` | TOML array of unique home paths, each at most 4096 bytes, such as ["~/src/agent-config"] | false | Unique explicit legacy HOME-relative roots; TOML string array. |
